current: No Curriculum Engine exists. current: The export exists, and it is synchronous with the reflex loop. qip-edge's CellUplink publishes a CellStateDelta every tick carrying the last pass's fills, refusals and reconciliation breaks - regional reflex experience - bounded per delta (MAX_FILLS_PER_DELTA, MAX_REFUSALS_PER_DELTA=64, with *_omitted counters), behind a circuit breaker, with a 64-entry in-memory dead-letter queue (qip-edge/src/mesh.rs; qip-edge-node/src/mesh.rs). qip-api drains those deltas into Platform::ingest_cell_report (qip-api/src/mesh.rs:1621), whose refusals feed the feasibility window a venue is withdrawn on - central learning from regional experience. A centre that accepts and then stalls therefore holds the next reflex pass for up to the read timeout per call until the breaker opens: a synchronous dependency of the hot path on the global sink, which this requirement forbids.
